data.case_title: Rejection of disabled parking permit application (Hamburg)
data.title: Rejection of application for a disabled parking exemption permit
data.summary: The Bezirksamt Beispielfleet (Hamburg traffic authority) rejected Thore Mustermöller's 5 October 2026 application for a disabled parking exemption permit (orange parking permit), dated 6 November 2026, because his disability assessment shows a GdB of 50 with no "G" mark, while the permit requires a GdB of at least 70 for lower-limb impairment together with the "G" mark.
data.explanation: This letter is a rejection decision (Ablehnungsbescheid), not just information. The authority says you may file an objection (Widerspruch) against this decision, and the letter itself states a one-month period for doing so, counted from when the decision is considered received. The app shows the exact deadline computed from that rule. If you believe your disability record is incorrect or additional evidence should be considered, you may file the objection in writing or in person with the Bezirksamt by the deadline shown; otherwise the rejection becomes final. Consider getting advice from a disability advocacy organisation (Sozialverband) if you want to contest the GdB rating itself.

remedy.quote: Widerspruch gegen diese Entscheidung können Sie binnen eines Monats nach ihrer Bekanntgabe beim Bezirksamt Beispielfleet, Fleetplatz 3, 21073 Hamburg, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift einlegen.

items.title: File an objection (Widerspruch) against the rejection
items.action: Decide whether to file a written objection with the Bezirksamt Beispielfleet against the rejection of your parking permit application, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the rejection becomes final.

key_facts.quote: Ihren Antrag vom 05.10.2026 auf Erteilung einer Ausnahmegenehmigung nach § 46 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 11 StVO lehne ich ab.
